I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread. The change is for Dock Door 4 during the second shift. The door is to be flagged out of service in Pemberline Dock for a hydraulic leveler repair at Quillfeather's Bozeman warehouse.

The source is Nadia's Oct 13 message in #strategic-random, a channel Ruth is in. That message doesn't say whether the change has been made or which dates the repair covers, so I told Ruth to check with Nadia.
